checks.exercise: Clean-grip deadlift with leg-driven initial ascent; front/side 16 poses and final light/dark 32-frame sheets reviewed.
checks.equipment: Straight standard-diameter barbell with two plates; grip visibly narrower than the snatch variant.
checks.setup: Hip-width stance, bar starts at floor, hips lower than the conventional axle variant.
checks.hands: Both hands remain outside legs and inside plates; long arms, overhand grip, no catch.
checks.feet: Both feet planted throughout; 481-pose drift below 7e-15 model units.
checks.movement: Initial back-angle drift below 4 degrees until bar clears knees, followed by hip extension. Controlled return and matching loop. Stylized shorts flare in side view; no simulated fabric or exhaustive cloth collision claim.

checks.exercise: Wide-grip snatch deadlift; front/side 16 poses and both final 32-frame sheets reviewed.
checks.equipment: Standard bar with two plates; wider grip than clean, hands still inside collars.
checks.setup: Lower starting posture and grip greater than twice shoulder width; floor start.
checks.hands: Wide overhand grip stays connected with long arms; no overhead pull or catch.
checks.feet: Fixed bilateral support without sliding in sampled poses.
checks.movement: Leg drive precedes hip opening; initial back-angle drift below 1.3 degrees until knee clearance. Smooth return with no sampled bar penetration. Side-view shorts flare retained as stylized garment limitation.
